cards.title: Methodological Calibration and Data Exclusion
cards.claim: MIC data is primarily from EUCAST/CLSI methods calibrated to ISO 20776-1/2. Zone data is exclusively from EUCAST disk diffusion. 10-20% of contributions are excluded, commonly due to 'lower end truncation'.
conditions: MIC methods must be reference or calibrated to reference
Zone data must be quality-controlled EUCAST disk diffusion
limitations: If a local distribution's wild-type mode differs by >=2 two-fold dilutions from the website's aggregated mode, it indicates methodological error or inadequate material
cards.downstream_use: Ensures comparability of MIC/Zone data across different laboratories and time periods.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
